lead:
We’ve built a platform that uses technology and innovation to expand access to nursing knowledge in
an environmentally responsible
way. We’ve optimized our code and infrastructure to deliver high performance and drastically reduce our carbon footprint.

secoes.corpo:
The internet consumes massive amounts of electricity. We treat
Core Web Vitals
metrics as ecological pillars. Fast websites process less data on servers and use less of the user’s battery power.

Through WebP compression and script minification, we ensure that each page view consumes as little electricity as possible.

Reduction in page weight (in KB) after optimization.

textoCompleto:
Digital Sustainability

Sustainability & Green Technology

We’ve built a platform that uses technology and innovation to expand access to nursing knowledge in
an environmentally responsible
way. We’ve optimized our code and infrastructure to deliver high performance and drastically reduce our carbon footprint.

Reducing Our Carbon Footprint
The internet consumes massive amounts of electricity. We treat
Core Web Vitals
metrics as ecological pillars. Fast websites process less data on servers and use less of the user’s battery power.

Through WebP compression and script minification, we ensure that each page view consumes as little electricity as possible.

Reduction in page weight (in KB) after optimization.

Efficiency and Clean Energy
We prioritize partners and cloud providers that are committed to renewable energy and have strict carbon neutrality goals.

We use highly efficient global
CDNs
. Data travels the shortest possible physical distance between the server and the user, saving on network infrastructure.

Desktop/Mobile Performance Trends.

Sustainable Technologies in Use

Pillars of Sustainability

Clean Code
We write optimized (Clean Code) and minimalist code. We eliminate heavy libraries and intrusive scripts, placing far less demand on your device’s CPU (mobile/computer).

Green Hosting
Our pages are hosted on modern global infrastructure. This reduces constant electricity consumption and ensures that the calculators load instantly in hospitals.

Inclusive Design
High-contrast interfaces and fluid layouts make reading easier, reduce unnecessary screen time, and are optimized to conserve battery life on OLED mobile devices.

Our Social Commitment
Sustainability goes hand in hand with education and governance. To understand the full structure that keeps the portal transparent and ethical, visit our institutional page.
